fieldValues.title: Two issues for one fix produce two PRs, and the second goes stale
fieldValues.summary: srs-rust#1342 (PR #1470, opened 2026-10-24) and srs-rust#1494 (PR #1498, merged 2026-10-27) both correct ADR-011's Neutral bullet on the schemars dependency. #1498 merged; #1470 then sat CONFLICTING with seven master merges and nothing left to add.
fieldValues.body:
- The filing rule (search before filing) existed and did not stop the second issue.
- The overlap is visible to clerk pr-tree (same-file edge) only once both PRs are open, too late to save the work.
